ui_bugs.issue: On hard-reload or direct URL entry to /profile, the page redirects back to / even for authenticated users. Root cause: useEffect fires `if (!user) nav('/')` while AuthProvider is still in loading=true (user=null momentarily until /api/auth/me resolves). Should gate the redirect on `!loading && !user`.

After seeding progress via API (or any state change outside the current tab), the top XP/Streak/Solved cards read from the stale AuthProvider `user` object and remain 0 even though the per-module 'Statistics: 20 solved · 100%' below is correct (fresh /api/progress fetch). Consider refreshing the user via `refresh()` inside the /progress useEffect.

action_items: Fix Profile.jsx redirect: change `if (!user) { nav('/'); return; }` to `if (!loading && !user) { nav('/'); return; } if (loading) return null;` (import `loading` from useAuth). This ensures direct-URL and hard-reload access to /profile work for authenticated users.
(Optional) In Profile.jsx after `api.get('/progress')` also call `refresh()` from useAuth so the top XP/Streak/Solved cards reflect current server state.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend is 100% solid — no changes needed on any of the iteration-2 endpoints. Only outstanding UI item is the Profile.jsx hard-reload redirect bug. Reproduce: log in (or seed localStorage 'datahub_token'), directly navigate to /profile (or hard-refresh on that URL) — page redirects to /. Fix: gate the `!user` redirect on `loading===false`. To verify fix: after fix, `page.goto('/profile')` should render [data-testid=profile-name] with the logged-in user's name. AI generation is real and takes 15-30s per question; count=1 is enough for testing. Certificate PDF download in the frontend was verified end-to-end (download event fires, file has %PDF magic bytes, filename is 'datahub-<module>-certificate.pdf'). Adaptive difficulty toast works after 5 consecutive correct answers in the same (module,difficulty); localStorage key `dh_streak_<module>_<difficulty>` must be cleared between runs to reproduce.
rca of the issue: Profile hard-reload redirect: /app/frontend/src/pages/Profile.jsx line 22-25 runs useEffect on mount with `if (!user) { nav('/'); return; }`. On any full page load, AuthProvider starts with user=null, loading=true, and asynchronously fetches /api/auth/me. The Profile useEffect fires before that promise resolves, so !user is true and the page navigates away. The AuthContext already exposes `loading` but Profile.jsx does not consume it. Mitigation: `const { user, logout, loading } = useAuth(); useEffect(() => { if (!loading && !user) nav('/'); }, [user, loading]);` and render a null / spinner while loading.
